company.name: Sight Verse
company.tagline: Step inside the built world before it exists.
company.intro: Welcome to our island. Each building is a part of our story - drag to look around, or click a building to step inside.

buildings.label: About Us
buildings.title: Engineers with an eye for the story
buildings.summary: We are a team of engineers, architects and real-time 3D specialists who believe a design should be experienced, not just drawn.

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: We turn plans, models and site data into immersive, photorealistic experiences that anyone can explore in a browser - no downloads, no special hardware.

sections.heading: How we work
sections.body: Engineering rigour first, then craft. Every project starts with accurate data and ends with an experience that makes stakeholders say "now I understand".

buildings.label: Services
buildings.title: From reality capture to real-time delivery
buildings.summary: A complete pipeline for architecture, engineering and construction teams who want to design, review and sell in 3D.

sections.heading: Real-time architectural visualisation
sections.body: Photorealistic walkthroughs and flythroughs built in Unreal Engine and delivered on the web.

sections.heading: Reality capture & Gaussian splatting
sections.body: Photogrammetry and radiance-field scans that turn real sites into navigable digital twins.

sections.heading: Interactive web experiences
sections.body: Branded 3D tours, configurators and sales tools that load in seconds and run in any browser.

sections.heading: BIM & digital-twin coordination
sections.body: Clean, optimised models prepared from your BIM/CAD data for review, presentation and handover.

buildings.label: Clients
buildings.title: Partners who build the future
buildings.summary: We collaborate with the people who shape our cities - and help them show their vision with confidence.

sections.heading: Developers & real-estate
sections.body: Pre-sale experiences that let buyers walk through a home long before the first brick is laid.

sections.heading: Architects & design studios
sections.body: Design-review tools that keep everyone looking at the same, up-to-date model.

sections.heading: Engineering & construction firms
sections.body: Progress visualisation and stakeholder presentations grounded in real site data.

sections.heading: Public sector & institutions
sections.body: Transparent, easy-to-understand consultations for planning and infrastructure projects.

buildings.label: Contact
buildings.title: Let's build something worth exploring
